user.title: Source sensors
user.description: Select thermal power delivered to the floor circuit. Heat input is assumed zero outside the chosen heating mode. Unitless temperature sensors are interpreted as degrees C.

parameters.title: Underfloor model and learning
parameters.description: Fit continuous heating and cooldown histories using all valid heating measurements, balanced per cycle. Scan the exponent range from multiple starts and validate on later complete cycles, including restart errors. Default exponent range: 1.0 to 1.6. No measurement or restart resets are applied to an initialized floor state. Manual coefficient edits restore manual calibration. Preview fits preserve active coefficients.

data.import_history_on_start: Import Recorder history once before the first automatic fit
data.legacy_linear_enabled: Enable legacy linear floor model (additional CPU and entities)

house.title: House digital twin (optional)
house.description: Two-state interior/envelope model from Bacher & Madsen (2011), Figure 1. Uses the room temperature selected on the first page. Solar must be irradiance in W/m² or kW/m². Check the source timestamp/averaging convention; hourly energy totals are unsupported. Manual defaults are starting guesses, not learned house properties. Existing floor operation is preserved when disabled. Combined occupancy and electrical heat gain enters the interior as a fitted constant, initially 500 W. The live twin corrects from the thermostat at local midnight; startup or recovery after missing inputs initializes from the room reading. Tomorrow demand reuses Open-Meteo forecast arrays and assumes steady state. Learning modes: fixed uses the configured value; prior learns with regularization; free learns without a gain prior. Both gains default to prior. Larger prior strengths retain dynamics closer to trusted starting values; zero disables that soft penalty. Provisional fitting cannot apply collapsed or physically bounded dynamics.

data.house_internal_gain: Manual occupancy and electrical heat gain (W)
data.house_dynamic_max_power: Maximum thermal pump output to floor (kW)

data_description.house_solar_uncertainty: Uncertain effective solar area. Higher values reduce solar influence on RC identification; 0 disables weighting and the separate gain stage. Validation always uses full weight.
data_description.house_solar_memory_hours: Decay time of the stored-solar exposure proxy used only for fitting weights.
data_description.house_heat_imbalance_minutes: A signed diagnostic over a complete measured window. Positive values indicate additional heat required by the observed room temperature.

error.house_unsupported_unit: Use W/kW for heat, °C/°F for outdoor temperature, and W/m² or kW/m² for solar irradiance.
error.invalid_exponent_range: The maximum fitted exponent must be greater than the minimum.

force.name: Force provisional fit
force.description: Bypass normal evidence and validation gates while retaining energy-signature constraints. Requires a continuous measured 24-hour training window (normally 32 total hours with holdout) and a converged finite fit. Preview by default; set apply true to activate provisional parameters. Numerical, physical and model-structure checks remain mandatory. Unsupported fitted dynamics retain trusted prior capacities and resistance split where feasible.
